content.text:
I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` to `data/2025-12.csv` and committed it as `2025-12: add rows`.

`scripts/check.sh` printed OK. I first ran it before the copy had happened, so I ran it again afterward. It checks the year set in `check.conf` (2025), so it did cover the new file.

The new file has a row with category `wholsale`, which looks like a misspelling. The same spelling is already in `data/2025-10.csv` and `data/2025-11.csv`, so I left it as it was. The check only counts fields per row, so it wouldn't catch this either way.
